Touring assisted living or memory care for a parent in Winnetka or nearby? Every place shows you the dining room. I put together a free one-page checklist of twelve questions that show you the rest: what the base rate includes and what is billed on top, how care levels are assessed and how often the price changes as a result, and what staffing looks like overnight. Print it and take it on every tour. No email or sign-up.

#employed Disclosure: I work at Westminster Place in Evanston. The guide is my own independent project, it includes an optional way to request a tour there, and I receive no referral fees.

https://evanstonseniorcareguide.com/?ref=fb-wnk-1120#tour
